history.summary: IDENTITY PROVISIONAL: the CSV name 'Shiva Temple, Kharkhoda' is generic, but Kharkhoda's documented ancient Shiva shrine is the Chhapadeshwar Mahadev Mandir, so the row is mapped to it - the match is an inference, not a confirmed identity. Per Wikipedia and Haryana press reports, the temple sits where the Mahabharata-era Khandav (Khandava) forest stood and local legend says Krishna and Arjuna stayed here; the temple and its pond fell into neglect until Brahmalin Mahant Shri Krishnadas Maharaj preserved the heritage in 1991, constructing a large cave-like temple here. A 71-foot-tall Shiva statue stands in the complex, about 250 m from Kharkhoda Bus Stand on the Rohtak-Sonipat road. The ancient-date and Mahabharata claims are traditional/legendary and unverified. CSV town/state error: the CSV 'state' column holds the town name ('Sonipat'); the correct state is Haryana.

name: Shiva Temple, Kharkhoda
town_description: Kharkhoda is a historic town in Sonipat district, Haryana, about 18-19 km west of Sonipat city on the Rohtak-Sonipat road. Local tradition associates the area with the Mahabharata-era Khandava forest, and it is known for the ancient Chhapadeshwar Mahadev Shiva shrine.

travel.airport: Indira Gandhi International Airport, Delhi, about 60-65 km from Kharkhoda.
travel.railway: Sonipat Junction, about 18-19 km, is the nearest major railway station.
travel.road: On the Rohtak-Sonipat road (VWM9+CWP, Rohtak-Sonipat Rd, Kharkhoda 131402), about 250 m from Kharkhoda Bus Stand; reachable via the Kharkhoda bypass from any corner of the town.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Maha Shivratri and the month of Sawan draw the biggest crowds.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Daily jalabhishek queues reportedly begin at 4:00 AM during Sawan; full daily hours not documented - verify locally before visiting.
